mechanism.claim: The Brock-Dechert-Scheinkman correlation-integral departure detects nonlinear serial dependence that is invisible to a single linear autocorrelation. When a completed high-variation BTC path newly enters the upper tail of positive two-dimensional BDS departure and its full-block and final-two-hour directions agree, follow the coherent direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour returns

external_basis.paper: Brock, Dechert, Scheinkman and LeBaron (1996), A test for independence based on the correlation dimension, Econometric Reviews 15(3), 197-235
external_basis.used_fact: under independence the m-dimensional correlation integral factors as the first-dimensional integral raised to m; a positive departure measures excess recurrence of nearby histories
external_basis.adaptation_disclosure: the fixed m=2 raw departure, epsilon, causal ranks, direction confirmation, clock and hold are preregistered BTC adaptations rather than a published trading rule

mechanism.why_distinct: Absolute-return clustering uses one lag autocorrelation, variance-ratio candidates compare linear aggregation scales, sign entropy and Lempel-Ziv discretize signs, and recurrence determinism counts diagonal structures after a separate recurrence construction. HVBDS directly compares the max-norm correlation integral of continuous standardized two-return histories with the square of its one-dimensional integral. It uses no volume, flow, funding, OI, premium, cross-asset, fitted outcome, reused event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both completed realized variation and nonlinear recurrence departure must occupy causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 03:05/11:05/19:05 UTC nonlinear-dependence onsets are absent from Gross9 clocks

features.block: 96 exact epoch-aligned five-minute bars aggregated from 480 unique coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.return: 96 log(five-minute close/open) returns, finite with strict-positive sample standard deviation
features.standardization: subtract arithmetic mean and divide by sample standard deviation over all 96 returns
features.correlation_integral_1: fraction of the 95 choose 2 unordered pairs of first coordinates z_t whose absolute distance is strictly less than epsilon
features.correlation_integral_2: fraction of the same 95 choose 2 unordered history pairs whose max-coordinate distance is strictly less than epsilon
features.departure_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared 96 five-minute returns), finite strict positive
features.block_return: log(last five-minute close/first five-minute open), finite strict nonzero
features.late_return: log(last close/open of the first bar in [D-2h,D)), finite strict nonzero
features.direction_confirmation: block and late returns have one common strict sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid prior cannot trigger

clock.side: common sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour returns
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent continuous nonlinear-dependence primitive selected from formula absence and complete source audit only; no prior outcome selected its statistic, epsilon, rank, direction, clock, or hold

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, standardization, embedding, epsilon, distance, correlation integral, departure, history, rank, variation, direction confirmation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, source, or control repair
